name: composio
description: Lets the assistant use the user's other apps (Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, HubSpot, Linear and 1000+ more) through Composio Connect, Composio's hosted MCP server. One browser sign-in to Composio connects it; each app is then connected on first use by a Composio sign-in link, with no API keys anywhere.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Lets the assistant use your other apps, like Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack and Notion. You connect each app with one sign-in link.

credentialCards.title: Connect Composio
credentialCards.label: Composio account
credentialCards.intro: Connect Composio to use your other apps. Sign in here, then approve each app separately when you need it.
usedFor: Finds tools for your other apps
Connects each app with your approval and carries out the tasks you request
credentialCards.keyHint: Browser sign-in only; this connection does not accept a pasted API key.
credentialCards.permissions: Connects tool discovery, schemas, account connections and requested app actions. App permissions are approved at each app’s own sign-in. Connection management and action execution need separate write grants; do not grant remote Bash or workbench tools.
